dct_description_sm: Blue line print map of Minneapolis with hand-drawn lines demarcating residential districts created under the 1913 zoning law. Shows: District(s) as authorized by Ordinance under 1913 Law; Additions to district(s) by Amendment; Subtractions from district(s) by Amendment; District(s) as authorized by Ordinance under Chapter 38, 1913 Law.; Additional title devised by cataloger.; Shows total area of city, area of residential districts, and percentage of city area contained in residential districts.; In pencil on map recto and verso: "1061/806."
